call_summary.keith_outlook: Quad 2 economic setup remains firmly in place, with momentum and signal strength as dominant investment factors; the emphasis is on riding high-beta growth winners and cutting losers quickly as market leadership remains concentrated in high-growth and AI-related equities amid a widening K-shaped economy.

key_points: Inflation acceleration is the dominant macro theme, with global interest rates hitting new cycle highs across US Treasuries, UK, Germany, and Japan — the core trade is Long Commodities (COM) vs. Short Long-term Treasuries (TLT).
Momentum is the strongest factor with the high beta momentum basket up ~60% YTD; key tech longs are NVDA, GOOGL, AAPL, and AMZN while MSFT, PLTR, and JPM are recommended shorts.
Long China (CNXT) / Short India (INDA) is a high-conviction, liquid Asia pair trade; Indonesia (IDX) also remains a short as an oil-importing emerging market with a crashing stock market.
Bitcoin is distinguished as a commodity long (recommended near the low end of its risk range), while Ethereum, Solana, and Avalanche have broken down technically and are bearish.

AI-driven quantitative signals are emphasized over narrative-based investing, with Hedgeye stressing strict adherence to algorithmic discipline — including rapidly exiting the KRE long when signals broke down.

DAR.thesis: DAR benefits from rising diesel prices and widening crack spreads creating favorable margins for renewable diesel producers, with a structural cost advantage from cheaper feedstock (animal tallow and used cooking oil). Additional catalysts include potential EPA policy updates and a strategic partnership with Valero enhancing scale and distribution in the biofuels market.

SWBI.thesis: Smith & Wesson Brands is a long as improving production and rising plant utilization are expected to drive meaningful margin expansion from depressed levels, with the company gaining market share amid competitor distraction and industry consolidation. Limited sell-side coverage and significant operating leverage from its fixed-cost structure offer asymmetric upside as earnings power builds.

MUSA.thesis: MUSA is levered to fuel price volatility and rate-of-change dynamics driving margin expansion and traffic through its price-led model, with a higher mix of gasoline, energy drinks, and nicotine sales positioning it to benefit disproportionately from improving consumer activity. With industry consolidation accelerating and a structurally advantaged sourcing model, MUSA offers a differentiated way to play both energy and consumer trends.

CZR.thesis: CZR remains a high-conviction long as accelerating Las Vegas fundamentals and improving demand trends drive near-term earnings upside, with RevPAR growth, stable gaming performance, and a strengthening convention calendar supporting continued momentum into Q2. The stock offers attractive risk/reward with ~35-40% upside potential, further supported by takeout optionality.

ULS.thesis: ULS is a high-quality, capital-light TIC franchise benefiting from a structural shift to a for-profit model unlocking sustained margin expansion and long-term alpha generation, positioned at the center of durable secular tailwinds including rising global regulation, AI/data center buildout, and industrial complexity. With a fragmented industry enabling M&A consolidation and multiple levers for growth, ULS can continue compounding earnings even in a Quad 3 macro backdrop.

CAVA.thesis: CAVA is a long as sustained traffic growth, best-in-class unit economics, and a differentiated Mediterranean positioning support a path back to HSD/double-digit comps and multiple expansion, with reinvestment in food quality, labor, hospitality, and loyalty creating a traffic flywheel. Unit growth remains productive with infill expansion, rising AUVs, and direct share gains from nearby Chipotle locations reinforcing the case for FY26 upside.

APD.thesis: APD remains a Best Ideas Long as new leadership shifts the company away from uneconomic green capital deployment back toward shareholder discipline, positioning the business to recover from years of self-inflicted underperformance. Industrial gases remain one of the highest-quality and most structurally resilient industries within Materials, and APD is positioned to outperform through 2026 as execution stabilizes.

PVH.thesis: PVH remains a sleeper long as accelerating Calvin Klein brand momentum and the ongoing recapture of key licenses from G-III are expected to drive a meaningful step-change in both revenue growth and margin expansion over the next several years. Earnings power is viewed as capable of inflecting from roughly $10-11 toward $14-15 as the transition progresses and estimate revisions accelerate.

ROP.thesis: Roper Technologies remains a serial acquisition story dependent on perpetual, near-flawless capital allocation and ever-larger deals to sustain the growth narrative, with the model obscuring underlying business quality and embedding significant execution risk as the pool of suitable assets shrinks. As software moats erode and niche verticals become more substitutable, ROP remains vulnerable to multiple compression and negative estimate revisions.

RBLX.thesis: RBLX remains a short with slowing user growth, as Hedgeye's proprietary tracker flagged decelerating new user acquisition confirmed by management cutting bookings guidance by ~14 points to an 8-12% range. A high-probability downside window exists into Q3 driven by toughest comps, age verification friction, and external competition from GTA 6.

ONON.thesis: ONON is a short as the CEO departure signals an inflection toward slower growth while current profitability and expectations remain unsustainably high, with gross margins above 60% facing meaningful downside as scale drives margin normalization and competitive pressures from Nike intensify. Decelerating growth and overly optimistic sell-side assumptions set up for estimate cuts and multiple compression.

OLLI.thesis: OLLI remains a high-conviction short as the company is underperforming despite what should be a peak operating environment, signaling structural weakness, with slowing comps, declining store productivity, and overexpansion into lower-quality locations. The business is likely transitioning to ex-growth while valuation still lacks meaningful multiple support.

HCA.thesis: HCA remains a short as weak MA rate relief fails to offset broader structural pressure on hospital reimbursements and payer-driven cost containment, with fundamental trends deteriorating across same-store admissions, wage inflation, surgical volumes, and real-time traffic data. Quad 3 macro headwinds and bearish Signal Strength support continued downside as earnings expectations reset lower.

WING.thesis: Wingstop remains a short as transaction data continues to deteriorate sharply with credit card activity down ~25% YoY and no evidence supporting the Street's expected same-store sales acceleration, while core initiatives including Smart Kitchen and loyalty are failing to drive incremental traffic. Structural pressures from declining AUVs, rising franchisee requirements, and signs of cannibalization reinforce the need to reset long-term unit growth assumptions.

from_desk.macro_view: The macro regime is firmly #Quad2 (Growth Accelerating + Inflation Accelerating) on a U.S. Monthly basis, with a down-dollar driving broad risk-on correlations across equities, commodities, and crypto. Higher-for-longer rates remain the operative framework as the Monthly Quad sequence runs 2-2-2-3 through August.
